g.text: Manually composed circuits. Same electrical interfaces. PROTOTYPE / UNVALIDATED.

g.text: J6 is a user button. Physical disable is J8; reset can cause a fall.

g.text: 04 Explicit ARM latch / physical disable loop

g.desc: 04 Explicit ARM latch / physical disable loop

g.text: NC pins are intentionally unused. SWD probe connects on the module top.

g.desc: NC pins are intentionally unused. SWD probe connects on the module top.

g.text: CLR_N dominates. Re-arm requires a new ARM_CLK edge; this is not a watchdog.

g.desc: CLR_N dominates. Re-arm requires a new ARM_CLK edge; this is not a watchdog.

g.text: 3.3 V logic; actuator thresholds and timing remain bench items.

g.text: SPI and DRDY belong to the rigid body IMU, not the head.

g.text: OE_N = request_N OR ARM_Q_N. Pull-ups disable TX by default.

g.desc: OE_N = request_N OR ARM_Q_N. Pull-ups disable TX by default.
